prerequisites: Having completed and passed the subjects of the first semester of the Module/Intensification.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of virtual prototype simulation techniques.
Computer modeling and simulation of multibody systems including both rigid and flexible bodies.
Dynamic analysis of multibody systems, including elements and systems.
Application of simulation techniques to fatigue, noise, and vibration calculation.

syllabus_topics: Integration of virtual prototype simulation tools (FEM, Matlab, fatigue, vibrations, etc.)

assessment_methods.method: Works and projects developed in classroom sessions

assessment_rules: The ordinary, extraordinary, and differentiated evaluation method is as detailed. For non-attendance students, the evaluation will be based on 50% works and projects, 10% oral tests, 10% practice exam, and 30% written tests.
bibliography: Kinematic and Dynamic Simulation of Multibody Systems. Javier García de Jalón y Eduardo Bayo. Ed. Springer Verlag
Computer aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical System. E. Haug.
The Multibody Systems Aproach to Vehicle Dynamics. M. Blundell and Damian Harty- Ed. SAE International
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Universitario en Ingeniería Industrial (EPI Gijón)
